svg.text: Autonomous TEC Atmospheric-Water-Harvesting PV Cleaning Robot
Multi-scale design for Egyptian new cities · REE 598 Senior Design Project I · R. El Hamouly · 2026
Wheeled row rover · 12-module TEC array · 82.8 L per cleaning event · 14-day interval
Pole-rail wiper · 1-module TEC · 0.63 L per event · fleet-scale deployment in new cities
Fleet: thousands of poles per city
Target: NAC, New Alamein, New Mansoura

g.text: TEC array + hot-side heat sink (Peltier stack)
Control: ESP32 + DHT22 + IMU + MPPT + comms

svg.text: Subsystem block diagram — identical architecture for Scale A / B / C (sized differently)
Energy (green) · Water (blue) · Control & sensing (amber) · Thermal reject (red)

g.text: ESP32 · state machine: HARVEST → IDLE → CLEAN → DOCK → FAULT
Sensors: DHT22 ×4 (amb. / cold / hot / tank), ACS712 current, IMU, ultrasonic level, current shunt on TEC string, RTC, wheel encoders, edge detection
Comms: Wi-Fi / LoRa to fleet gateway
New Administrative Capital · New Alamein · New Mansoura · New Ismailia — street-lamps, commercial rooftops, residential villas supporting Egypt's sustainable-future roadmap.
